findings: A native burned-in-boiler MJ service can represent fuel input, while a separate Heat process represents delivered output and includes an efficiency wrapper. Identical MJ labels are insufficient for interchangeability.

Four boiler candidates have production amounts different from one; preserve actual production quantity when deriving per-output energy factors. Do not rewrite their production to one without scaling all exchanges consistently.

A native heat pump includes direct electricity, refrigerants and equipment. Use its inspected delivered-heat reference and actual electricity draw; preserve complete nonenergy inventory and canonical biosphere links.
Three IAM layers are present; 28 technology roles have positive values. Secondary solar is present but zero in this particular scenario, so another valid scenario is needed to exercise it.

The existing Heat constructor defaults to ecoinvent InventorySet aliases and calls get_biosphere_code(self.version); passing2026would use the wrong axis. Existing market names, frozen residual supply and relinking targets are also ecoinvent-specific.
Default heat role matching finds no reviewed uvek_aliases. Partial heuristic candidates, IAM availability or a finite native source LCI do not demonstrate an operational heat sector.
next_actions: Review and bind exact native delivered-heat counterparts for all positively used building, industrial and secondary roles. Trace nested burner/fuel services for source-derived final-energy conversion, excluding unrelated upstream energy and infrastructure.
Record complete functional proxy boundaries for absent technologies, fuel provenance, CHP allocation, distribution and frozen residual composition; never relabel a fossil/synthetic fuel as biomass.

Implement family-aware heat dispatch, mapping, canonical3.10biosphere and linked-supplier energy factors, with strict preflight and complete audits. Preserve native producer/scenario ownership and prevent recursive heat-market links.

Verify layered IAM quantity conversion, signed caller quantities and uncertainty, cold/warm equivalent suppliers, public combined update/certification/export and isolated package readback before opening the public heat gate.

energy_basis_stage.tests: 46 new/reference-basis and existing heat regressions passed; Black and Ruff passed.
energy_basis_stage.scope: Pure read-only conversion evidence. Traverse explicit exact supplier routes; account for actual production quantities and preserve all process exchanges. Fuel/electricity frontiers require reviewed MJ per supplier unit, with no guessed LHV/density/moisture factor. Excluded conversion-boundary inputs are audited, not removed from LCI. Nominal factors do not propagate supplier uncertainty or prove physical suitability.
energy_basis_stage.oil_boundary: For the inspected native oil boiler, stop at its documented one-MJ fuel-input combustion service. Do not infer a kg-based LHV from the source label or replace it with a generic fuel value.
